review_comment: The duty „დაცვის მეორე ხაზმა უნდა აცნობოს პირველ ხაზს" is an operating duty of the second line, not something an internal audit report must state; F1 even records an unperformed validation. The proposed section 3.4 would put a policy duty into an audit report. The gold label (RAMD analysts who built M-001 helped with recalculations, §3.2, an independence problem) is a different issue and the system did not see it.

„უნდა მოხდეს ... ალტერნატიულ თეორიებთან შედარება" is a first-line model-building duty; an audit report need not describe it, so its absence is not a gap. The proposed section 4.1 copies the regulation into the audit report.

„უნდა შეფასდეს ... თვისებრივი ინფორმაცია, მსჯელობა და ლოგიკა" is a duty of the second-line internal validation, not of the third-line audit report. Whether the audit tested validation documentation is covered in §2.1, so this is not an audit gap, and the proposed 4.1 section would put the validators' duty into the report.

The duty to run additional analysis when results differ from the benchmark model („საორიენტაციო მოდელს შორის განსხვავების") is a monitoring/validation procedure, not an audit-report content item. An audit report that does not describe it has no gap, and the proposed addition is a misplaced duty.

„მოდელის რისკის მნიშვნელოვანი ცვლილებები ... უნდა გახდეს მოდელის გამოყენების შეზღუდვის ან შეჩერების საფუძველი" is a duty of the model user's governance and policy. An audit report does not need to state it, and the proposal turns a regulatory duty into a statement in the report.

„მოდელის გამომყენებელი სუბიექტი არის მოდელის მესაკუთრე და პასუხისმგებელი პირი" is a status and policy duty of the bank, not a duty of an audit report. The report's silence on ownership is not a gap, and the proposed section merely copies the regulation into the report.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the report does not address unavailable third-party documentation; F1 does address the lack of supplier limitations/assumptions and the reliance on the vendor report.
review_comment: The duty „მოდელის გამომყენებელ სუბიექტს უნდა გააჩნდეს საკუთარი მონაცემები ... ტესტირება მის შეძენამდე" belongs to the bank as model user, not to the audit report. The audit's F1 already reports the related M-007 problem, and the proposed section 2.3 would insert a bank duty into the audit scope.

review_unsupported_claims: The 'missing' element about confirming that all models state limitations and assumptions is not in art5/p10.1; the system's evidence is only loosely related to transparency. Evidence quote at §5.1 is accurate.
review_comment: The audit concludes „პოლიტიკა და მმართველობითი სტრუქტურა ზოგადად შეესაბამება დებულების მოთხოვნებს" while §2.1–§3.1 contain no test of transparency or explainability (art5/p10.1, in force from 2022), so the audit confirms compliance only in part, matching the gold point that explainability, ethics and deviation tests are absent. The system reaches this through the vendor-report gap, which is a weaker link than the missing audit test, and the proposal only adds a gap sentence to the conclusion instead of an audit procedure.
